observation: In a consumer repository, agent-loop enter replaced a full semantic agent-map index with a Contract-scoped structural build twice: 3422 files to 12 when one Contract file lay outside the indexed paths, and 3464 files to 14 when a scoped file had changed since the last refresh. Afterwards agent-map callers reported no matches for a method with 10 real callers.

evidence.summary: New regression test proves a foreign-backend index stays byte-identical and a structural index keeps unrelated files; the former replace-expectation test now asserts a semantic map is patched; composer ci exit 0 at ced2817.

hypothesis: rebuildMap() only carried a previous index forward when its backend was structural-only, so any semantic index was replaced instead of patched.
validated_conclusion: Automatic discovery repair must patch the Contract scope with the builder whose backend matches the recorded index, and must leave an index it cannot reproduce untouched rather than replace it.
